---- MODULE W4Od9m4p2t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Feeders == {"f1", "f2", "f3"}
TotalPower == 4
QMax == 2
Amounts == {1, 2}

VARIABLES pool, committed, queue, shed, inbox

vars == <<pool, committed, queue, shed, inbox>>

RECURSIVE SumOver(_)
SumOver(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE
         IN committed[x] + SumOver(S \ {x})

CommittedTotal == SumOver(Feeders)

ActiveFeeders == {r.f : r \in (inbox \cup queue \cup shed)}

Init ==
    /\ pool = TotalPower
    /\ committed = [f \in Feeders |-> 0]
    /\ queue = {}
    /\ shed = {}
    /\ inbox = {}

Submit(f, a) ==
    /\ committed[f] = 0
    /\ f \notin ActiveFeeders
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[f |-> f, amt |-> a]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, committed, queue, shed>>

Enqueue(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ Cardinality(queue) < QMax
    /\ queue' = queue \cup {m}
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, committed, shed>>

ShedReq(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ Cardinality(queue) >= QMax
    /\ shed' = shed \cup {m}
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, committed, queue>>

Serve(m) ==
    /\ m \in queue
    /\ pool >= m.amt
    /\ committed[m.f] = 0
    /\ pool' = pool - m.amt
    /\ committed' = [committed EXCEPT ![m.f] = m.amt]
    /\ queue' = queue \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shed, inbox>>

Release(f) ==
    /\ committed[f] > 0
    /\ pool' = pool + committed[f]
    /\ committed' = [committed EXCEPT ![f] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, shed, inbox>>

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Feeders, a \in Amounts : Submit(f, a)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Enqueue(m)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : ShedReq(m)
    \/ \E m \in queue : Serve(m)
    \/ \E f \in Feeders : Release(f)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \in 0..TotalPower
    /\ committed \in [Feeders -> 0..TotalPower]
    /\ queue \subseteq [f : Feeders, amt : Amounts]
    /\ shed \subseteq [f : Feeders, amt : Amounts]
    /\ inbox \subseteq [f : Feeders, amt : Amounts]

Conservation ==
    pool + CommittedTotal = TotalPower

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A power-grid load shedder manages a fixed pool of TotalPower generation units.
Feeder requests arrive over an unordered fabric and land in an inbox as a set,
so they may be picked up in any order (messages can be reordered). A bounded
admission queue applies backpressure: a request is enqueued only while the queue
holds fewer than QMax entries; once the queue is full, further requests are shed
outright rather than queued. Serving a queued feeder moves power units out of the
free generator pool and into that feeder's committed allocation; releasing a
feeder returns exactly those units to the pool. Power units are never minted or
lost -- they only move between the free pool and the committed allocations.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The free generator pool plus the sum of all committed feeder allocations always equals TotalPower, so no power unit is ever created or destroyed.

---- MODULE W4Od13m1p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Rings == {"A", "B"}
Slots == {1, 2}
NodeIds == Rings \X Slots
NONE == <<"none", 0>>
MaxEpoch == 4
Capacity == 3

VARIABLES tokLoc, epoch, badge, cs, stock

vars == <<tokLoc, epoch, badge, cs, stock>>

Init ==
    /\ tokLoc = <<"A", 1>>
    /\ epoch = 1
    /\ badge = [n \in NodeIds |-> IF n = <<"A", 1>> THEN 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ cs = NONE
    /\ stock = Capacity

PassToken(to) ==
    /\ cs = NONE
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ to # tokLoc
    /\ tokLoc' = to
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ badge' = [badge EXCEPT ![to] = epoch + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cs, stock>>

Enter(n) ==
    /\ cs = NONE
    /\ tokLoc = n
    /\ badge[n] = epoch
    /\ stock > 0
    /\ cs' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokLoc, epoch, badge, stock>>

Dispense ==
    /\ cs # NONE
    /\ stock > 0
    /\ stock' = stock - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokLoc, epoch, badge, cs>>

Exit ==
    /\ cs # NONE
    /\ cs' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokLoc, epoch, badge, stock>>

Recharge ==
    /\ stock = 0
    /\ stock' = Capacity
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokLoc, epoch, badge, cs>>

Next ==
    \/ \E to \in NodeIds : PassToken(to)
    \/ Recharge
    \/ \E n \in NodeIds : Enter(n)
    \/ Dispense
    \/ Exit

TypeOK ==
    /\ tokLoc \in NodeIds
    /\ epoch \in 1..MaxEpoch
    /\ badge \in [NodeIds -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ cs \in NodeIds \cup {NONE}
    /\ stock \in 0..Capacity

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Authorized
nl:
A vending-machine network runs two independent service rings, A and B, that
share a single stock pool. Exclusive access to the shared pool is granted by one
circulating token stamped with an epoch number. A node may only enter its
dispensing critical section while it physically holds the token and the token's
current epoch matches the badge stamped on it when the token last arrived. Each
time the token is passed to another node the epoch advances, which makes every
previously stamped badge stale. A node whose badge no longer matches the current
epoch is a stale participant and must never dispense from the shared pool, even
though it may still believe it holds a token. Passing the token is forbidden
while a node is mid-dispense.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever any node is dispensing, it is the current token holder and its badge equals the current epoch, so no stale or unauthorized node ever touches the shared pool.

---- MODULE W4Od12m4p6t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Sessions == {"u1", "u2", "u3"}
NONE == "none"
QMax == 2
Capacity == 2

VARIABLES valid, inbox, queue, cur, stock

vars == <<valid, inbox, queue, cur, stock>>

Active == inbox \cup queue \cup (IF cur = NONE THEN {} ELSE {cur})

Init ==
    /\ valid = Sessions
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ queue = {}
    /\ cur = NONE
    /\ stock = Capacity

Submit(s) ==
    /\ s \notin Active
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<valid, queue, cur, stock>>

Admit(s) ==
    /\ s \in inbox
    /\ Cardinality(queue) < QMax
    /\ s \in valid
    /\ queue' = queue \cup {s}
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<valid, cur, stock>>

DropStale(s) ==
    /\ s \in queue
    /\ s \notin valid
    /\ queue' = queue \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<valid, inbox, cur, stock>>

Grant(s) ==
    /\ cur = NONE
    /\ s \in queue
    /\ s \in valid
    /\ stock > 0
    /\ cur' = s
    /\ queue' = queue \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<valid, inbox, stock>>

Complete ==
    /\ cur # NONE
    /\ stock' = stock - 1
    /\ cur' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<valid, inbox, queue>>

Revoke(s) ==
    /\ s \in valid
    /\ valid' = valid \ {s}
    /\ cur' = IF cur = s THEN NONE ELSE cur
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, queue, stock>>

ReAuth(s) ==
    /\ s \notin valid
    /\ valid' = valid \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, queue, cur, stock>>

Restock ==
    /\ stock = 0
    /\ stock' = Capacity
    /\ UNCHANGED <<valid, inbox, queue, cur>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Sessions : Submit(s)
    \/ \E s \in Sessions : Admit(s)
    \/ \E s \in Sessions : DropStale(s)
    \/ \E s \in Sessions : Grant(s)
    \/ Complete
    \/ \E s \in Sessions : Revoke(s)
    \/ \E s \in Sessions : ReAuth(s)
    \/ Restock

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ valid \subseteq Sessions
    /\ inbox \subseteq Sessions
    /\ queue \subseteq Sessions
    /\ cur \in Sessions \cup {NONE}
    /\ stock \in 0..Capacity

Authorized ==
    cur # NONE => cur \in valid

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Authorized
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker fulfils crossmatch requests, each tied to a
clinician session. Requests arrive over an unordered channel and sit in an inbox
set, so they may be processed in any order. A bounded admission queue applies
backpressure: a request is admitted only while the queue holds fewer than QMax
entries and only if its session is currently valid. Fulfilment is done one unit
at a time: the tracker grants a single queued request into an exclusive
processing slot -- again checking the session is still valid -- then completes it
by releasing one unit of stock. A clinician session can be revoked at any time
(for example on shift change); when a session is revoked while its request is the
one being processed, that in-flight request must be dropped immediately. A stale
request that lingers in the queue after its session was revoked is never granted.
When stock runs out it is restocked, and a revoked session may later be re-authorized.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The request occupying the processing slot always belongs to a currently valid session, so no revoked or stale clinician ever draws a blood unit.

---- MODULE W4Od9m2p4t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Feeders == {"f1", "f2"}
Relays == {"r1", "r2"}
Capacity == 4
Amounts == 0..3
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES draw, phase, prop, votes

vars == <<draw, phase, prop, votes>>

RECURSIVE SumOver(_, _)
SumOver(S, override) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE
         IN (IF x = override THEN 0 ELSE draw[x]) + SumOver(S \ {x}, override)

TotalExcept(f) == SumOver(Feeders, f)
Total == SumOver(Feeders, "nofeeder")

Init ==
    /\ draw = [f \in Feeders |-> 0]
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ prop = [part |-> NONE, amt |-> 0]
    /\ votes = [r \in Relays |-> NONE]

Propose(f, a) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ prop' = [part |-> f, amt |-> a]
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ votes' = [r \in Relays |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED draw

Vote(r, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[r] = NONE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![r] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<draw, phase, prop>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A r \in Relays : votes[r] = "yes"
    /\ TotalExcept(prop.part) + prop.amt <= Capacity
    /\ draw' = [draw EXCEPT ![prop.part] = prop.amt]
    /\ phase' = "done"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prop, votes>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E r \in Relays : votes[r] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "done"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<draw, prop, votes>>

AdminOverride ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ TotalExcept(prop.part) + prop.amt <= Capacity
    /\ draw' = [draw EXCEPT ![prop.part] = prop.amt]
    /\ phase' = "done"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prop, votes>>

CapReject ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A r \in Relays : votes[r] = "yes"
    /\ TotalExcept(prop.part) + prop.amt > Capacity
    /\ phase' = "done"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<draw, prop, votes>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase = "done"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ prop' = [part |-> NONE, amt |-> 0]
    /\ votes' = [r \in Relays |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED draw

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Feeders, a \in Amounts : Propose(f, a)
    \/ \E r \in Relays, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(r, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ AdminOverride
    \/ CapReject
    \/ Reset

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ draw \in [Feeders -> Amounts]
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting", "done"}
    /\ prop \in [part : Feeders \cup {NONE}, amt : Amounts]
    /\ votes \in [Relays -> {NONE, "yes", "no"}]

CapacityHeld ==
    Total <= Capacity

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityHeld
nl:
A power-grid load shedder decides which feeders may draw power using two-phase
commit across the grid's protection relays. A coordinator proposes setting a
feeder's committed draw to some amount; every relay then votes yes or no, and the
allocation commits only on a unanimous yes -- and only if the new grid-wide total
would still fit within the hard interconnect Capacity. If any relay votes no the
round aborts, and a unanimous yes that would breach Capacity is rejected too. A privileged grid operator holds an admin override that can force a
proposed allocation through without waiting for relay votes; the override still
respects the Capacity limit, because exceeding it would trip the whole
interconnect. After a commit, abort, or override the coordinator resets to idle.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The sum of all feeders' committed draws never exceeds the interconnect Capacity, whether an allocation was committed by unanimous vote or by admin override.

---- MODULE W4Od13m5p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Machines == {"m1", "m2", "m3"}
NONE == "none"
Capacity == 2

VARIABLES members, ballot, phase, prop, stock

vars == <<members, ballot, phase, prop, stock>>

Init ==
    /\ members = Machines
    /\ ballot = {}
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ prop = NONE
    /\ stock = Capacity

Propose(item) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ phase' = "collecting"
    /\ prop' = item
    /\ ballot' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<members, stock>>

CastVote(m) ==
    /\ phase = "collecting"
    /\ m \in members
    /\ m \notin ballot
    /\ ballot' = ballot \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<members, phase, prop, stock>>

Join(m) ==
    /\ phase # "committed"
    /\ m \notin members
    /\ members' = members \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ballot, phase, prop, stock>>

Leave(m) ==
    /\ phase # "committed"
    /\ m \in members
    /\ members' = members \ {m}
    /\ ballot' = ballot \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, prop, stock>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "collecting"
    /\ 2 * Cardinality(ballot) > Cardinality(members)
    /\ stock > 0
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ stock' = stock - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<members, ballot, prop>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "collecting"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ ballot' = {}
    /\ prop' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<members, stock>>

Reset ==
    /\ phase = "committed"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ ballot' = {}
    /\ prop' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<members, stock>>

Restock ==
    /\ stock = 0
    /\ stock' = Capacity
    /\ UNCHANGED <<members, ballot, phase, prop>>

Next ==
    \/ \E item \in {"cola", "water"} : Propose(item)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : CastVote(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Join(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Leave(m)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Reset
    \/ Restock

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ members \subseteq Machines
    /\ ballot \subseteq Machines
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "collecting", "committed"}
    /\ prop \in {NONE, "cola", "water"}
    /\ stock \in 0..Capacity

QuorumSound ==
    /\ ballot \subseteq members
    /\ (phase = "committed" => 2 * Cardinality(ballot) > Cardinality(members))

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT QuorumSound
nl:
A vending-machine network dispenses shared promotional stock only after the
machines agree by quorum vote. To dispense, a coordinator opens a proposal and
each machine that is a current network member may cast one vote. Machines join
and leave the network at runtime, so the membership -- and therefore the majority
quorum threshold -- changes as the system runs. A proposal is committed and one
unit dispensed only when the votes gathered form a strict majority of the current
membership. Crucially, only votes from current members count: when a machine
leaves the network, any vote it already cast is withdrawn, so a departed or stale
machine can never prop up a quorum. Network reconfiguration pauses once a round is committed; the round is then reset back to idle, and a
collecting round may be aborted. Empty stock is restocked.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every vote counted toward the current proposal belongs to a current network member, and a proposal is committed only when its votes form a strict majority of the present membership.

---- MODULE W4Od6m7p6t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Controllers == {"c1", "c2", "c3"}
NONE == "none"
MaxCap == 3

VARIABLES reg, cs, cap, active

vars == <<reg, cs, cap, active>>

Init ==
    /\ reg = NONE
    /\ cs = NONE
    /\ cap = MaxCap
    /\ active = 0

CasAcquire(c) ==
    /\ reg = NONE
    /\ reg' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cs, cap, active>>

CasRelease(c) ==
    /\ reg = c
    /\ cs # c
    /\ reg' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cs, cap, active>>

Preempt(c, d) ==
    /\ reg = c
    /\ cs = NONE
    /\ d # c
    /\ reg' = d
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cs, cap, active>>

EnterCS(c) ==
    /\ cs = NONE
    /\ reg = c
    /\ active < cap
    /\ cs' = c
    /\ active' = active + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, cap>>

ExitCS ==
    /\ cs # NONE
    /\ cs' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, cap, active>>

Retire ==
    /\ active > 0
    /\ active' = active - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, cs, cap>>

SetCap(k) ==
    /\ k >= active
    /\ cap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, cs, active>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : CasAcquire(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : CasRelease(c)
    \/ \E c, d \in Controllers : Preempt(c, d)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : EnterCS(c)
    \/ ExitCS
    \/ Retire
    \/ \E k \in 1..MaxCap : SetCap(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ reg \in Controllers \cup {NONE}
    /\ cs \in Controllers \cup {NONE}
    /\ cap \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ active \in 0..MaxCap

Safe ==
    /\ (cs # NONE => reg = cs)
    /\ active <= cap

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper coordinates dispatches through a single
compare-and-swap dispatch register. A floor controller must first win the
register by CAS -- claiming it only while it reads as free -- before it may issue
a dispatch command. The register can be preempted: a supervisor may reassign the
register from one controller to another while no dispatch is executing, which
leaves the previously-winning controller stale. A stale controller, whose claim
no longer matches the register, must never issue a dispatch. The number of cars
the bank may run concurrently is a capacity that operators change at runtime, but
it is never lowered below the number of cars currently in service. Issuing a
dispatch puts a car in service; cars later retire out of service. A controller
releases the register only when it is not mid-dispatch.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The controller executing a dispatch always currently owns the compare-and-swap register, and the number of cars in service never exceeds the runtime capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od3m0p5t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Instr == {"i1", "i2", "i3"}
Accts == {"A", "B"}
amt == [i1 |-> 1, i2 |-> 2, i3 |-> 1]
src == [i1 |-> "A", i2 |-> "B", i3 |-> "A"]
Open == [A |-> 5, B |-> 5]
MaxCap == 3

VARIABLES balance, status, version, cap

vars == <<balance, status, version, cap>>

RECURSIVE SumDone(_, _)
SumDone(S, a) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE
             rest == SumDone(S \ {x}, a)
         IN IF status[x] = "done" /\ src[x] = a THEN amt[x] + rest ELSE rest

Batched == {i \in Instr : status[i] = "batched"}

Init ==
    /\ balance = Open
    /\ status = [i \in Instr |-> "new"]
    /\ version = 0
    /\ cap = MaxCap

Admit(i) ==
    /\ status[i] = "new"
    /\ Cardinality(Batched) < cap
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![i] = "batched"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, version, cap>>

Unbatch(i) ==
    /\ status[i] = "batched"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![i] = "new"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, version, cap>>

Settle(i, readv) ==
    /\ status[i] = "batched"
    /\ readv = version
    /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![src[i]] = balance[src[i]] - amt[i]]
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![i] = "done"]
    /\ version' = version + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

SetCap(k) ==
    /\ k >= Cardinality(Batched)
    /\ cap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, status, version>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instr : Admit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instr : Unbatch(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instr, readv \in 0..MaxCap : Settle(i, readv)
    \/ \E k \in 1..MaxCap : SetCap(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ balance \in [Accts -> 0..10]
    /\ status \in [Instr -> {"new", "batched", "done"}]
    /\ version \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ cap \in 1..MaxCap

Conserved ==
    \A a \in Accts : balance[a] = Open[a] - SumDone(Instr, a)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch applies a set of settlement instructions,
each debiting a fixed source account by a fixed amount. Settlement uses
optimistic locking: the batch carries a version counter, and an instruction is
committed only when the settler's read version still matches the current version;
otherwise the settler must re-read and retry. Committing an instruction is
irreversible -- it moves money and marks the instruction done -- and each
instruction must be applied at most once, so its money moves exactly one time.
Instructions are first admitted into an active batch whose capacity operators
change at runtime, but capacity is never set below the number of instructions
currently batched. A batched instruction may be pulled back out before it settles.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Each source account's balance always equals its opening balance minus the summed amounts of exactly those instructions marked done, so no irreversible settlement is ever applied twice.

    /\ queue' = queue \cup {o}
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {o}

    /\ orderSlot[o] = NONE
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![s] = o]
    /\ orderSlot' = [orderSlot EXCEPT ![o] = s]

    /\ orderSlot[o] = NONE
    /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![s] = o]
    /\ orderSlot' = [orderSlot EXCEPT ![o] = s]

        (slotOwner[s] = o) <=> (orderSlot[o] = s)

NEXT Next
INVARIANT Consistent
nl:
A stock-exchange opening auction assigns scarce execution slots to incoming
orders. Orders first land in an inbox, then pass through a bounded admission
queue that applies backpressure: an order is admitted only while the queue holds
fewer than QMax entries. A queued order is allocated an execution slot only if
that slot is currently unowned and the order does not already hold a slot; the

    /\ cs = NONE
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ to # tokLoc
    /\ tokLoc' = to
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ badge' = [badge EXCEPT ![to] = epoch + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cs, stock>>

    /\ cs = NONE
    /\ tokLoc = n

    /\ stock > 0
    /\ cs' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokLoc, epoch, badge, stock>>

    /\ cs # NONE

    /\ stock' = stock - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokLoc, epoch, badge, cs>>

Exit ==
    /\ cs # NONE
    /\ cs' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokLoc, epoch, badge, stock>>

Recharge ==
    /\ stock = 0
    /\ stock' = Capacity
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokLoc, epoch, badge, cs>>

    \/ Recharge
    \/ \E n \in NodeIds : Enter(n)
    \/ Dispense
    \/ Exit

dispensing critical section while it physically holds the token and the token's
current epoch matches the badge stamped on it when the token last arrived. Each
time the token is passed to another node the epoch advances, which makes every
previously stamped badge stale. A node whose badge no longer matches the current
epoch is a stale participant and must never dispense from the shared pool, even
though it may still believe it holds a token. Passing the token is forbidden
while a node is mid-dispense. Dispensing draws down the shared stock, and when the
stock is exhausted it is recharged back to full capacity so service can continue.
